source_evidence: An easy way to do this is to have your bank automatically deposit money from your paycheck into a savings or investment account.
answer: Automatic contributions can help you make saving or investing part of your regular financial routine. The source describes having your bank automatically deposit money from your paycheck into a savings or investment account as an easy way to pay yourself first. Include savings and investing in your monthly income-and-expense tracking so you can see how they fit into your finances.
